task: binary classification: anti-inflammatory peptide probability, sigmoid(logit)
architecture: three branches fused by interaction features. Global: frozen ESM2-150M residue embeddings pooled by BOS + mean + max + attention, then an MLP. Local: N-terminal and C-terminal windows (10 and 20 residues) plus up to 6 cleavage-centred windows (radius 5), each embedded by ESM2, passed through a CNN (k=3, 5) with attention pooling, a window-type embedding and a 2-layer Transformer. Handcrafted: 626 sequence descriptors reduced to 80 by variance, correlation, mutual-information and random-forest selection. Fusion: [g, l, h, g*l, g*h, l*h, |g-l|, |g-h|, |l-h|] into a 3-layer classifier.
weights_layout: weights.pt: state_dict, feature_index (80 selected descriptor columns), feature_mean, feature_scale
differences_from_v1: uses frozen ESM2-150M embeddings and 626 handcrafted descriptors instead of a one-hot encoding, so a call needs the shared FeatureExtractor
no fixed 25-residue input: longer sequences are scored in full and flagged as outside the trained range, not truncated

training.variant: extended: every training peptide also contributes a random crop (at least 8 residues), its reverse and a copy with about 10% of positions substituted, duplicates dropped, then the minority class is oversampled to 1:1 (18040 training examples)
training.checkpoint_selection: the epoch with the best sqrt(MCC x AUC) on the training set itself (epoch 50 of 50); there was no validation split

independent_test_metrics_without_trainin.note: independent peptides with no training peptide at or above the stated sequence identity

verification: model_store loader (platform ESM2 extractor, fp32) reproduces the training-code scores: AUC 0.8089 / 0.8993, MCC 0.4702 / 0.7022, ACC 0.7474 / 0.8518 on independent sets 1 / 2; largest per-peptide probability difference over 120 peptides is 0.011, no peptide changes side of 0.5. Repeated calls are identical.
limits: The independent sets overlap the training set heavily: 29% of set 1 and 54% of set 2 are exact sequence matches, and 30% and 70% have a training neighbour at 0.8 identity or more. The headline AUCs (0.81, 0.90) are therefore optimistic; the 0.70 and 0.79 figures at identity below 0.8 are the cautious ones, and at identity below 0.6 the model is close to chance on set 1 (AUC 0.55, n=343).

The extended variant was chosen over the base variant because it scored higher on these same independent sets (AUC 0.809 / 0.899 against 0.790 / 0.861), so the choice itself used the test data and adds a small optimistic bias.
Checkpoint selection used the training set, and accuracy on its own (augmented) training set is 0.999 and AUC 0.9999: the model overfits.

Trained on peptides of 11 to 30 residues (augmented crops down to 8). Outside 8 to 30 residues the score is extrapolation: it is returned with a warning, and predict_batch sets in_length_range to false. The platform accepts up to 50.
Sensitivity and specificity are balanced at 0.5 on the independent sets but the decision threshold was not tuned.
One seed only; no estimate of seed-to-seed variation.
